Rubber Band Library 4.0.0 (R3 Finer engine), Copyright 2007-2024 Particular Programs Ltd.
https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/
License: GPL-2.0-or-later, or a separate commercial licence from the copyright holder.
See COPYING. Preserve this notice and corresponding source when distributing.
This integration's new DSP bridge/adapters are GPL-2.0-or-later.

This distribution builds the official release plus short-offline.patch, a local
2026-10-20 correction to R3Stretcher.cpp: pending offline start compensation must
not consume the effective output duration budget for very short selections.
The patch changes two expressions; no audio algorithm is replaced.

Corresponding source (served alongside this notice):
  rubberband-4.0.0.tar.bz2  official complete release
  short-offline.patch     local upstream modification
  bridge.cpp             project WASM bridge
  build.sh               complete compilation recipe
  adapters.tar.gz        TypeScript adapters (browser Worker + Node + core)
  COPYING                GNU GPL version 2; upstream permits version 2 or later

Official release SHA256:
  af050313ee63bc18b35b2e064e5dce05b276aaf6d1aa2b8a82ced1fe2f8028e9
Production reference WASM SHA256 (local rebuilds may differ due to embedded source paths):
  59215ceebe9dc618d1a88aefe1d0030ff519bda4e7b44fb0d45b8e02aac8fd37
Compiler: Emscripten 3.1.6, Ubuntu noble package 3.1.6~dfsg-7, clang 15,
  builtin FFT + builtin BQ resampler, single compilation unit, -O3 -flto,
  no fast-math, no threading, no SIMD requirement, standalone WASM.
Options: 0x20110000 = EngineFiner | ThreadingNever | WindowShort,
  ProcessOffline, WindowShort, mono, pitch scale 1. Runtime asserts engine 3.
